_meta.name: adversarial_v2
_meta.description: SYNTHETIC adversarial corpus v2 for lg-sotf eval (AI-E6.1): log-field persona and instruction hijacks, tool-output injection with canned threat-intel and history answers, response steering, encoding tricks and benign look-alikes. Hand-written; labels by construction. Tests the pipeline and its safety policy, not detection accuracy.
